name: Globe Visitors Counter
author: vectormapper

sections.description:
Globe Visitors Counter (Lite) adds a lightweight, iframe-isolated visitor globe to your site. It’s a visual indicator users instantly understand.

  • Privacy-friendly: no external trackers; simple JSON logs saved locally.
  • Cache-friendly: viewer is served from uploads and isolated in an iframe to avoid theme/plugin conflicts.
  • Accessible defaults: rotation can be tuned or disabled; reduced-motion setups work well.
  • Shortcode-based: works in both Classic and Block editors.
  • Land-Cover map style included. Additional styles and automatic header injection are available in the Premium versions.

How it works

The Lite plugin seeds a small viewer bundle into /wp-content/uploads/visitors-lite-landcover/.
When you place the shortcode on a page, it loads that HTML/JS bundle in an iframe and logs visits to a local JSON file. Nothing is sent to third-party analytics platforms.

Tester Program (community build)
We’re tuning defaults and performance for future releases of Globe Visitors Counter.
If you’re willing to share brief feedback from your setup (theme, cache/CDN), we can enable advanced features during testing at no cost (e.g. heatmap, styling presets).
How to join: reply in the Support topic and we’ll follow up with the testing build and quick start:
https://wordpress.org/support/topic/looking-for-testers-free-advanced-features-for-feedback/

Usage

Shortcode:

[visitors_globe_lite title="VISITORS" width="100%" height="600"]

Attributes:

  • title — optional title shown in the small header above the globe.
  • width — width of the iframe container (for example 100% or 600px).
  • height — height of the iframe in pixels (for example 600).

Place the shortcode into any page or post (Classic editor or Block editor).
After saving, open the page on the front-end — the 3D Land-Cover globe will appear in the content area.
sections.installation:
1. In WordPress go to Plugins → Add New and search Globe Visitors Counter, then Install → Activate,
    — or — upload the ZIP and activate.
  2. Create or edit a page or post where you want to show the globe.
  3. Add the shortcode [visitors_globe_lite title="VISITORS" width="100%" height="600"] to the content.
  4. Update the page and open it — the globe is served from /wp-content/uploads/visitors-lite-landcover/index.html; visits are logged to visitors.json in the same folder.
sections.faq:
Does it collect personal data?

The Lite version stores a minimal JSON log locally in /wp-content/uploads/visitors-lite-landcover/visitors.json in order to draw the globe and aggregate visit counts. Data is not sent to external analytics services.

Is it compatible with caching/CDN?

Yes. The widget is iframe-isolated and plays well with common stacks (LiteSpeed/LSCache, WP Rocket, Autoptimize, Cloudflare). If you see issues with JS minify/defer, exclude the page with the globe from aggressive optimisation.

Shortcode or block?

The shortcode is the primary integration method. You can also wrap the shortcode in a block (Shortcode block / Paragraph in the Block editor).
sections.changelog:
1.5.1

  • Lite version simplified to a single Land-Cover globe style.
  • Settings screen cleaned up and focused on shortcode usage + upgrade links.
  • Viewer engine aligned with the commercial Land-Cover build.
  • Internal seeding updated to keep viewer files in /wp-content/uploads/visitors-lite-landcover/.

1.2.1

  • Enhancement: Expanded world cities dataset to 7,342 places (was ~1,000).
  • Improvement: ASCII-only city names, duplicates removed.
  • Note: File name unchanged (cities_1000.json) for compatibility.

1.1.9

  • Added Tester Program section (community build; Support-first workflow).
  • Improved defaults & wording for accessibility (reduced motion) and cache-safe behavior.
  • Admin notice inviting testers (dismissible).

1.1.8

  • Rename display name to Globe Visitors Counter.
  • Lower “Requires at least” to 5.4 (compat confirmed).
  • Minor description updates.
